manual: Fields are text unless a type follows the name. ? marks an optional field.
Card text holds no clock time or time zone. Pass a moment in an ISO time field, such as observedAt: 2026-10-05T03:17:00Z. The card shows it in the viewer's time zone.

Every kind accepts {title, meta? (short header context), source?, sourceBrand?, updatedAt? (a freshness label without a clock time, such as "截至 9/22"), observedAt?: ISO time (when the facts were read), actions?: [{label, prompt}] (<= 2; a click proposes the prompt like comma.request)}.
tone: neutral | brand | success | warning | error
condition: clear | clear-night | partly-cloudy | cloudy | rain | snow
state: done | current | upcoming
status: text or {label, tone?}
delta: {value (the change as shown, with its unit and no sign: "37.6%"), direction?: up | down | flat, good?: boolean (whether the change is good; without it a rise is good and a fall is not)}
url: an HTTPS URL
zone: an IANA time zone such as Asia/Tokyo; the card shows a moment beside it in that zone
fact: {label, value}
control: {label, prompt}
cell: text, a number, {text, tone?} to color the text, or null or "" for an empty cell

forecast (weather for one place: now, today or the coming days): {location?, current?: {temperature: number, condition?, label?, feelsLike?: number, humidity?: number (percent), wind?}, days?: [{label, condition, conditionLabel, high: number, low: number, precipitation?: number (percent)}] (<= 7), highlight?}; needs days or current; layouts: today (needs current), week, compact (current and <= 2 days)

options (choices to pick one from, such as trains, flights, hotels or plans): {items: [{primary, id?, secondary? (arrival time), span?, meta?, price?, priceNote?, status?, tags?: [text] (<= 3), reason?, recommended?: boolean, filterKeys?: [text] (<= 8)}] (1 to 8), filters?: [{key, label}] (<= 4)}; layouts: timetable and list (every item has secondary), pick (no item has secondary)

metric (one to six key numbers, or progress toward a goal): {metrics?: [{label, value (display text), unit?, delta?, caption?, series?: [number] (<= 64)}] (<= 6), goal?: {current: number, target: number, valueLabel, targetLabel, note?}}; needs metrics or goal; layouts: single (1 metric), grid (2 to 6), goal (with any metrics under it)

trend (how numbers change over time, or a watchlist of prices; a number per category is bars): {brand?, value?, delta?, ranges?: [{key, label, points: [number] (2 to 64), axis: [text] (<= 6)}] (<= 4), bars?: {labels: [text] (1 to 31), values: [number] (1 to 31), valueLabels?: [text] (<= 31), averageLabel? (names the dashed line at the mean of the bars, such as "日均 217")} (one bar per period, oldest first; the last bar is the current one), series?: [{label, value, points: [number] (2 to 64), brand?, delta?}] (<= 6)}; needs ranges, bars or series; bars.labels has as many entries as bars.values; layouts: area (ranges), bars, watchlist (series)

comparison (two or three subjects compared attribute by attribute): {subjects: [{name, caption?, recommended?: boolean, brand?}] (2 to 3), rows: [{label, values: [text or null] (<= 3; one per subject; null shows a dash), best?: integer >= 0 (subject index), scores?: [number from 0 to 10] (2 entries)}] (1 to 8), verdict?}; rows[].values has as many entries as subjects; layouts: columns, table (<= 4 rows), versus (2 subjects, scores on every row)

schedule (a day's events, an itinerary of one or several days, or the stages of a process; ISO event times show in zone, where the events happen, or on the viewer's clock without it): {zone?, now?, events?: [{start (a clock time such as "09:30", or an ISO time), title, end?, detail?, state?, tone?}] (<= 8), stages?: [{label, state, detail?}] (2 to 6), summary?}; needs events or stages; layouts: agenda and timeline (events), stages

checklist (things to do, pack or check off): {groups: [{label?, items: [{label, id?, detail?, done?: boolean, actions?: [{label, prompt}] (<= 3; this item's follow-ups, such as adding it to the calendar, reminders or Routine; a click proposes the prompt like comma.request)}] (>= 1)}] (1 to 4; at most 20 items in total)}; layouts: progress, grouped (2 or more groups)

composition (how a total splits into parts that add up to it): {total: text or number, totalLabel?, segments: [{label, value: number >= 0, valueLabel?, muted?: boolean}] (1 to 6)}; layouts: stacked, donut

place (places to go: nearby results or recommendations): {places: [{name, category?, note? (what it is or why it fits, in one line), rating?: number, reviews? (a review count such as "2,310 条评价"), status?, address?, distance?, eta?, href?: url}] (1 to 8)}; layouts: single (1 place), nearby (2 or more)

feed (news, updates and status lists such as a day's pull requests, issues or CI runs; over 12 items show title, status, source and time, and each filter shows its count): {items?: [{source, title, brand?, excerpt?, time? (a label such as "2 小时前"), at?: ISO time (when it happened), status?, tags?: [text] (<= 3), href?: url, filterKeys?: [text] (<= 8)}] (<= 60), filters?: [{key, label}] (<= 4), groups?: [{source, summary, brand?, count?: integer >= 0, tone?}] (<= 6)}; needs items or groups; layouts: news (<= 12 items), list (items without excerpts or tags, or over 12), digest (groups)

timer (a countdown to a moment, a focus timer, or days until an event): {label, endsAt?: ISO time, remainingSeconds?: number, daysLeft?: number, totalSeconds?: number, paused?: boolean, phase?: focus | break, cycle?: {current: integer >= 1, total: integer from 1 to 8}, date?, elapsedRatio?: number from 0 to 1, note?}; needs endsAt, remainingSeconds or daysLeft; layouts: countdown, event (daysLeft)

order (one order and where it is: a purchase, a takeout or a parcel; title names the merchant or carrier): {brand?, orderId?, status (where the order is, such as "正在出库"), arrival? (the expected arrival without a clock time, such as "预计 10月29日 周四 送达"), arrivesBy?: ISO time (the latest arrival moment, shown on the viewer's clock), items?: [{name, quantity?: integer >= 1, detail? (a variant such as size or color), price?}] (<= 6), total?, totalLabel? (such as "实付"), address?, stages?: [{label, state}] (2 to 5)}; layouts: tracking (stages), receipt (an item with a price, or a total), compact

ticket (one train or flight ticket, or a boarding pass; title names the carrier): {brand?, mode?: train | flight, number (train or flight number), depart: {place (station, airport or stop), code? (such as PVG), at: ISO time, zone?, terminal?}, arrive: {place (station, airport or stop), code? (such as PVG), at: ISO time, zone?, terminal?}, duration?, details?: [fact] (<= 4; such as seat, gate, cabin or boarding time), passenger?, status?, reference? (booking reference or e-ticket number)}; layouts: ticket, pass

ride (a ride on its way or under way; title names the service): {brand?, status (such as "司机正在赶来"), eta? (such as "3 分钟"), plate?, car? (color and model), driver?: {name, rating?: number, trips?}, pickup?, dropoff?, fare?}; layouts: pickup (plate), trip (pickup and dropoff)

product (products to buy, with images and prices): {products: [{name, image?: url, price, originalPrice?, badge? (such as "券后" or "包邮"), shop?, rating?: number, sales? (such as "月销 2万+"), href?: url}] (1 to 6)}; layouts: hero (1 product), grid (2 to 6), list

booking (a reservation or appointment: a table, a room, a doctor; title names the venue): {brand?, status?, at: ISO time (when the booking starts), zone?, details?: [fact] (<= 6; such as party size, room or department), confirmation?, address?}; layouts: confirmation, compact

device (smart home devices, their state and controls): {devices: [{name, on?: boolean, online?: boolean (false shows it offline), value? (the main reading, such as "26"), unit? (such as "°C" or "%"), mode?, detail?, controls?: [control] (<= 4)}] (1 to 6)}; layouts: single (1 device), grid (2 to 6)

payment (a payment, transfer or refund and its result; title names the provider): {brand?, amount, status, counterparty? (who was paid, or who paid), at?: ISO time, details?: [fact] (<= 5; such as payment method, fee or reference)}; layouts: receipt, compact

media (what is playing, or a song or video to play; title names the service): {brand?, track (song, episode or video), artist?, album?, cover?: url, playing?: boolean, position?: number >= 0 (seconds), duration?: number >= 0 (seconds), controls?: {previous?, toggle?, next?} (a prompt per button, proposed like an action), queue?: [{track, artist?}] (<= 5)}; layouts: player, queue (needs queue)

bars (a number per category, each a labelled bar: rankings such as top sources, pages or products, survey answers, rating distributions, funnel steps, budget against actual, progress per goal): {items: [{label, value: number, valueLabel? (how the value reads, such as "¥4,500" or "72%"), compare?: number (the same measure in the other series: the previous period, a budget, a target), compareLabel?, delta?, caption? (a short second line, such as "转化 25% · 中位 38 秒"), status?, tone?, brand?, href?: url}] (1 to 12), max?: number (what a full bar stands for, such as 100 for percentages or a goal; without it, the largest value), legend?: {value, compare} (names the two bars of each item, such as {value: "昨日", compare: "前天"})}; layouts: rows, compact (short labels, no captions or statuses), columns (2 to 7 items with short labels, values only and no max)

table (rows and columns of facts that no other kind shows: a leaderboard with several numbers, orders, hosts and their readings, more than three subjects compared, a cohort grid): {columns: [text] (2 to 8; a heading per column; "" leaves one without), rows: [[cell]] (1 to 24; the first cell names the row)}; rows[] has as many entries as columns; layouts: grid
